question: Across two schedule geometries, how asymmetric is the held-out cost of deploying an exact raw-Nesterov rate fitted for one outer age at every other target age?

forbidden_now: create a v14 result root or attempt directory
create a node-facing launch manifest, controller, queue, or command packet
start, reserve, or probe an H200 scientific process
treat a gatesim draw as scientific evidence
future_launch_prerequisites: a clean pushed descendant containing this unchanged scientific contract
a frozen analyzer that mechanically implements this contract and cites its own raw SHA-256
hash-bound materialized train and held-out files identical across execution nodes
a loss-blind launch manifest enumerating exactly the 160 registered cells
an explicit future launch authority created while no v14 outcome exists
authority.outcome_aware_changes_forbidden: No pair, context, rate, seed, estimand, clipping limit, interval, margin, label, or asymmetry rule may change after any v14 endpoint exists.

g4c_readout.canonical_location: h200-n1:/root/g4c-readout.json (banked; absent from the CPU evacuation archive)

g10_readout.reason_for_null: the strict original rule required all three directed intervals to clear 0.178542 bits; the downward T20-to-T5 interval was mild

rate_prescriptions.exact_decimal_rule: Every decimal below is passed verbatim; rate-grid snapping, float rounding for presentation, target refitting, and outcome-aware replacement are forbidden.

fixed_H512_derivation.T2: eta5*(2/5)^p with p=log(eta20/eta5)/log(20/5)=-0.9782799412400243; this is a prospective extrapolated prescription, not a measured 1.7B T2 optimum
fixed_H512_derivation.T40: v11 pre-outcome far-horizon prescription 0.003800560784723474*(1-0.9)*1.044905865516022; v11 was deferred, so this remains predicted rather than measured

fixed_S2560_transport.disclosure: The coefficients are frozen G6/G9 placement coefficients. Fixed-S prescriptions, and especially T40, are transported placements rather than measured 1.7B optima.

design.pair_rule: all ordered source-target pairs with source_T != target_T
design.fresh_comparator_rule: For each context, target T, and seed, execute one fresh comparator at the exact target prescription. Its endpoint is shared by the three directed transfers entering that target and is never imported from banked work.
design.fresh_transfer_rule: For each directed pair, context, and seed, deploy the exact source prescription at the target H,S schedule.
design.cell_count_identity: (12 directed transfers + 4 per-target comparators) * 2 contexts * 5 seeds = 160

heldout_jsonl.exclusion: not used to derive any registered source or target rate

data_and_evaluation.paired_raw_penalty: heldout_bits(exact source rate at target)-heldout_bits(exact target comparator), paired by context, target, and fresh seed

analysis_contract.pair_primary_estimand: the mean across five seeds after symmetrically clipping each paired raw penalty to [-0.75,+0.75] bits/token
analysis_contract.bounded_influence_rationale: G10 retained a finite +9.504814-bit scientific-divergence seed. The fixed symmetric cap prevents one endpoint from defining a five-seed inferential claim; no raw endpoint is deleted or relabeled.
analysis_contract.mandatory_raw_reporting: For every pair report all five unclipped penalties, their raw mean and SD, the bounded values, bounded mean, and interval.
analysis_contract.interval: two-sided 95% paired Student t interval with df=4 and t*=2.7764451051977987

per_pair_classification.PAIR_NO_DECISIVE_PENALTY: every other complete finite result; this label is not an equivalence claim

analysis_contract.execution_incomplete_rule: Missing or invalid required evidence emits no pair label and no v14 asymmetry verdict; it is recovered only under the registered loss-blind retry rule.
analysis_contract.shared_pairing: All pair and aggregate intervals preserve the same five seed indices; reuse of a target comparator is retained in the covariance rather than treated as independent evidence.

preregistered_asymmetry_hypothesis.scientific_statement: Upward transfer (a short-age rate deployed at a longer target age) is penalized, whereas downward transfer is mild and lies inside the 0.10-bit practical band.
preregistered_asymmetry_hypothesis.origin: G10 and its independent audit: young-to-mature transfers were large and positive while T20-to-T5 was mild.

seed_statistics.upward: for each seed, equal-weight mean of all 12 upward bounded penalties across both contexts
seed_statistics.downward: for each seed, equal-weight mean of all 12 downward bounded penalties across both contexts
seed_statistics.difference: upward minus downward, paired by seed

classification.ASYMMETRY_CONFIRMED: the paired 95% interval lower endpoint for upward-minus-downward is >0.10, the upward interval lower endpoint is >0.10, and abs(downward point estimate)<=0.10
classification.ASYMMETRY_REVERSED: the paired 95% interval upper endpoint for upward-minus-downward is <-0.10

gate_feasibility.interpretation: Every one of the 24 pairs is separately simulated with bounded G10 and worst-SD G4C banked seed profiles. These probabilities measure rule behavior under the declared alternative, not the truth of the alternative.

completed_cell_requires: exact registered source commit and command identity
all four learners complete exactly S optimizer steps
exactly 4*T strict-quorum fragment commits and matching rho telemetry
finite 1024-row held-out endpoint and successful learner/syncer exits
hashes for command, evidence, results, tape, telemetry, checkpoint, source commit, and source diff
allowed_retry_reasons: registered process timeout without a valid endpoint
evidence_and_retry.retry_unit: all four cells sharing context, target T, and seed: the three source transfers plus their fresh target comparator
evidence_and_retry.forbidden_retry_reasons: finite unfavorable loss, scientific divergence, pair label, asymmetry label, or any desire to change a rate
